missing_vs_unscored_vs_miss: three states kept apart: unscored (no exact rank: pipeline/mapping fact), retrieval_failure (rank > K), hit (rank <= K); see backend/composition.py:1181-1232 and metrics.py:168-172
gap_formula: 1 - max(nDCG_text, nDCG_image) / nDCG_multimodal on the cohort scored in ALL THREE conditions (metrics.py:126-148); gap_cohort_count is that intersection
notes: One scoring call yields both the rank and the stored window (adapters.py:392-409). DCNet refuses (`ScoringNotReproducible`) rather than faking a fixed matrix (model_dcnet.py:145-155). mask_scope: adapters do NOT inherit the native reference mask (model_encoder.py:227, model_dcnet.py:96).
